1/2 cup all-purpose flour ~65g; standard white flour values
1 tablespoon icing sugar ~12g; nearly pure sucrose

1/4 tsp ground black pepper; modest quantity for seasoning
1/4 tsp garlic powder; modest quantity for seasoning
1/4 tsp celery salt; modest quantity for seasoning
1/2 tsp cayenne pepper; modest quantity for seasoning
1 cup olive oil total listed but only ~2-3 tbsp actually absorbed; pure oil has no carbs
1 standard sesame seed burger bun ~50-60g; typical enriched white bun values
